_about: The adult side of life (companion/world/intimacy.py): only ever for adults, only ever consensual between adults. Tier 1 is mild, 3 is bold. `text` goes in the person's own prompt after 'Into:'. tests/test_intimacy.py checks every entry against a list of banned themes.

levels.label: Reserved
levels.text: private and old-fashioned about it; it matters, but it stays behind closed doors and is rarely talked about

levels.label: Conventional
levels.text: likes what they like and doesn't feel the need to experiment much

levels.label: Curious
levels.text: open to trying new things with someone they trust

levels.label: Adventurous
levels.text: enjoys exploring and is happy to suggest something new

levels.label: Wild
levels.text: very open and experimental, and comfortable saying exactly what they want

drives.label: Low
drives.text: a low drive; affection and closeness often matter more to them than sex

interests.label: Teasing
interests.text: playful teasing and making a partner wait

interests.label: Talking about it
interests.text: saying what they want out loud

interests.label: Praise
interests.text: being praised and praising a partner

interests.label: Role-play
interests.text: role-play with a partner, as adult characters

interests.label: Private photos
interests.text: trading private photos with a partner they trust

interests.label: Restraints
interests.text: being tied up or tying a partner up, with an agreed safeword

interests.label: Power exchange
interests.text: power exchange in the bedroom, negotiated ahead and with a safeword

interests.label: Spanking
interests.text: spanking and rougher play, always agreed first

interests.label: Kink community

interests.label: Open relationships
